scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:v2: for pkg in v2-core v2-linear v2-valuation v2-views v2-affordances; do pnpm --filter "@workspace/$pkg" test || exit 1; done
scripts.test:offline:rest: pnpm run test:v2 && pnpm --filter @workspace/engine test:unit && for pkg in ui-kit player-web; do pnpm --filter "@workspace/$pkg" test || exit 1; done && pnpm run test:ci-scripts
